deckTitle: The Pelvic Proving Grounds — MedKayfab OB/GYN

cards.power: THE LINING-BUILDER. Fortifies the Uterine Fortress.
cards.lore: THE FORTRESS IS NEVER UNPREPARED.
cards.gradeReason: Architect role is instant. Swan in hardhat at Cervical Gate — zero ambiguity.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Steampunk editorial. Subject: Regal swan in hard hat laying carpet at fortress gate. Mood: Imperial.

cards.power: THE WALL-BREAKER. Fortifies the Fortress Sealer.
cards.lore: KEEPS THE LINING READY. If she leaves early, the carpet tears up (Menses).
cards.gradeReason: Bulldog security guard at vault — caretaker role clicks without instruction.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Crime-noir comics. Subject: Bulldog bouncer guarding uterine vault door in luteal corridor. Mood: Vigilant.

cards.lore: ROUNDS UP THE CANDIDATES. Only the strongest becomes the Gladiator.
cards.gradeReason: Cheetah recruiter blowing whistle past Ovarian Bench — sport metaphor lands instantly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Sports-action comic. Subject: Leopard coach sprinting past ovarian bench candidates with whistle. Mood: Urgent.

cards.lore: BURSTS THE FOLLICLE AND CONVERTS THE EMPTY SHELL INTO PAUL.
cards.gradeReason: Rhino with sledgehammer at wrestling arena — trigger role is physical and unambiguous.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Pro-wrestling poster. Subject: Rhino swinging sledgehammer at follicle-shaped door. Mood: Explosive.

cards.lore: FIRST SIGN OF LIFE. Stalling numbers mean Outlaw or Null.
cards.gradeReason: Signalman role crisp — doubling every 48 hours coded into character name rhythm.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Retro radio-operator illustration. Subject: Cartoon creature sending distress flare upward. Mood: Hopeful.

cards.lore: SURGICAL EMERGENCY. Rupture floods belly with haemorrhage.
cards.gradeReason: Raccoon outlaw camping in fallopian tube — wrong-place metaphor is instantly iconic.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Wanted-poster western. Subject: Raccoon camped at glowing campfire inside a tube. Mood: Dangerous.

cards.lore: NEGOTIATES BORDER BETWEEN BLOODSTREAMS. Fueling early stops oxygen.
cards.gradeReason: Octopus interface is conceptual — needs context to perform, though artwork carries the analogy.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Biopunk illustration. Subject: Octopus straddling two bloodstream rivers mid-air. Mood: Fragile balance.

cards.lore: DRIVEN BY HIGH BENNY-hCG. Needs Fluid-Floods and B6-Shield.
cards.gradeReason: Owl inside cyclone labeled Hyperemesis — visceral and memorably unpleasant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Disaster-movie comic. Subject: Nauseated owl spiraling in green vortex. Mood: Relentless.

cards.lore: LOW SCORE MEANS GATE IS UNRIPE. Ends in C-Section-Sideshow.
cards.gradeReason: Bishop Score as bouncer checking cervical ID — grading rubric clicks as gatekeeping metaphor.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Club-door illustration. Subject: Gorilla bouncer at cervical gate reviewing clipboard. Mood: Authoritative.

cards.lore: TOO MUCH CAUSES TACHYSYSTOLE, choking oxygen supply.
cards.gradeReason: Drill sergeant enforcing synthetic contractions — synthetic Oxytocin as military escalation is perfect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Military-drill comics. Subject: Sergeant commanding muscular red muscle-bears in formation. Mood: Aggressive.

cards.lore: STATION 0 IS ENGAGED. +4 means Crowning-Crown appears.
cards.gradeReason: Miner descending with level markers is the cleanest fetal station metaphor possible.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Mining adventure illustration. Subject: Hard-hatted miner on ladder with numbered station markers. Mood: Methodical.

cards.lore: 5-MINUTE EMERGENCY. Use McRoberts-Maneuver to unlock gate.
cards.gradeReason: Turtle stuck at Pubic Bone Shield — obstruction metaphor is physical and unforgettable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Emergency-drama comics. Subject: Turtle wedged immovably at stone gate labelled pubic bone. Mood: Critical.

cards.lore: CONSTRICTS PIPES. Erupts in Seizure-Storm if not delivered.
cards.gradeReason: Snake wrapped in pressure gauges — vascular constriction threat is embodied without explanation.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Industrial-horror illustration. Subject: Coiled serpent wrapped around pressure gauges, steam escaping. Mood: Explosive tension.

cards.lore: CNS DEPRESSANT. Loss of Reflex-Ray means Mag is too strong.
cards.gradeReason: Sedated sloth on a chain = CNS depression made visible. Mag-too-high warning embedded in lore.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Pharmacology character art. Subject: Drowsy chained sloth with reflexes dimming. Mood: Heavy, tranquilized.

cards.lore: OXYGEN-LINK BROKEN. Race to OR to save the Fetal-Fighter.
cards.gradeReason: Grizzly bear tearing through backdrop with blood spray — abrupt catastrophe embodied perfectly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Trauma-action comics. Subject: Enraged bear ripping through placental wall with hemorrhage. Mood: Urgent chaos.

cards.lore: MUSCLES TOO TIRED TO SQUEEZE PIPES SHUT. Needs Fundal-Massage.
cards.gradeReason: Exhausted hippo sprawled mid-bleed — postpartum hemorrhage as collapsed fighter is direct.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Medical-drama illustration. Subject: Exhausted hippo collapsed and bleeding in delivery arena. Mood: Depleted.

cards.lore: ESCAPED TISSUE RESPONDS TO STELLA-ESTROGEN, bleeding and scarring.
cards.gradeReason: Spider with spreading web of endometrial tissue — cyclic invasion is instantly visualized.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Body-horror illustration. Subject: Ornate spider spinning bloody webs across pelvic anatomy. Mood: Insidious.

cards.lore: INSULIN RESISTANCE CREATES HOSTILE SPARK-RING. Stops ovulation.
cards.gradeReason: Porcupine electrified with Androgens label — hormonal hostility is made physical and pointy.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Electro-punk comics. Subject: Spiky porcupine radiating androgen lightning, egg blocked behind. Mood: Hostile.

cards.lore: THE BULKY-UTERUS QUEEN. Estrogen sensitive. Makes menses heavy.
cards.gradeReason: Armadillo works for hard, tough lump but bulkiness needs context to feel performative.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Fantasy-creature illustration. Subject: Heavy armadillo curled in uterine space, pressing outward. Mood: Immovable.

cards.lore: HIJACKS CELL P53-BRAKES. Caught early by the Pap-Brush.
cards.gradeReason: Wolf in transformation zone describes rather than invites — slow-invader framing is explanatory.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Surveillance-thriller comics. Subject: Wolf prowling circular transformation zone under Pap-brush searchlight. Mood: Lurking.

cards.lore: OPPORTUNIST. Takes over when antibiotics kill the Lacto-Garde.
cards.gradeReason: Polar bear with crown in cottage-cheese gate setting — opportunist queen is immediately playable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Fairy-tale-parody comics. Subject: Fluffy crowned polar bear taking over stone archway with white discharge. Mood: Self-satisfied.

cards.lore: GARDNERELLA OVERGROWTH. Replaces good guards with biofilm.
cards.gradeReason: Fish creature amid puzzle-piece Clue Cells — Amsel criteria embedded visually and in name.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Microbiology horror comics. Subject: Grey fish exhaling green clue-cell cloud in vaginal corridor. Mood: Fishy menace.

cards.lore: STI. Requires the Metronidazole-Hammer for both partners.
cards.gradeReason: Green flagellated creature with strawberry-cervix arena — treat-both-partners rule is in lore, instant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Sci-fi parasite art. Subject: Spinning flagellated green creature foaming at strawberry-red gate. Mood: Infectious.

cards.lore: SNAPPED LIGAMENT CABLES. Needs Pessary-Plug or Surgical-Sling.
cards.gradeReason: Kangaroo descent concept requires explaining the pouch-to-prolapse link at table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Anatomical adventure comics. Subject: Kangaroo descending with bladder-bowel-uterus falling through pelvic net. Mood: Gravity wins.

cards.lore: DRIVEN BY UNOPPOSED ESTROGEN. Any menopausal blood is Edna.
cards.gradeReason: 'Any menopausal blood is Edna' is one of the best mnemonic lore lines in the corpus.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Villain portrait comics. Subject: Badger in red lining, bleeding defiantly post-menopause. Mood: Rebellious.

cards.lore: HARD TO CATCH. Grows quietly in the basement with room to hide.
cards.gradeReason: Bat spreading in basement darkness = late-stage silent ovarian cancer. Chilling and accurate.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Gothic horror illustration. Subject: Bat spreading in dark basement cavern, unseen until large. Mood: Silent dread.

cards.lore: PRIMITIVE EGG CELL ORIGIN. Usually benign, but causes Torsion-Twist.
cards.gradeReason: Platypus-with-teratoma-globe is creative but germ-cell tumor mechanism needs unpacking at table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Curiosity-cabinet illustration. Subject: Platypus holding snow globe containing teeth-hair-bone mix. Mood: Weird wonder.

cards.lore: MOLAR-PREGNANCY WITH DAD'S DNA ONLY. Can attack lungs.
cards.gradeReason: Ghost of a pregnancy that never was — 'hCG in the millions' as haunting statline is perfect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Medical ghost story comics. Subject: Translucent ghost-cluster floating in snowstorm ultrasound scene. Mood: Haunting.

cards.lore: RELAXES SMOOTH MUSCLE. Causes maternal racing heart and tremors.
cards.gradeReason: Sloth referee blowing TIME-OUT at muscle-bears = tocolysis as sports timeout. Unmissable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Sports-referee comics. Subject: Sloth referee in striped shirt holding TIME-OUT sign at charging bears. Mood: Pause.

cards.lore: STOPS FAST-GROWING CELLS. Melts Eddie if hCG isn't too high.
cards.gradeReason: Cobra dissolving the ectopic-raccoon's campfire — callback to Eddie is cross-deck storytelling at its best.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Chemical-showdown illustration. Subject: Green cobra shooting laser dissolving raccoon campfire in tube. Mood: Surgical precision.

cards.lore: TRICKS BRAIN INTO THINKING ESTROGEN IS LOW, forcing more FSH.
cards.gradeReason: Fox-brain-tricking illustration locks SERM mechanism into memory without a word of pharmacology.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Spy-con comics. Subject: Fox whispering lies to giant brain that releases FSH jets. Mood: Cunning.

cards.lore: STOPS Rh-NEGATIVE MOM FROM ATTACKING Rh-POSITIVE FUTURE-FIGHTER.
cards.gradeReason: Three-dog-army scenario captures the mechanism but requires explaining immunology chain at table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Military-immune system comics. Subject: Large dog in bandana blindfolding army of small attack dogs. Mood: Protective.

cards.lore: NO LH SURGE = NO OVULATION. No egg = No match.
cards.gradeReason: 'NO VACANCY' neon sign is the single best contraception visual in any card deck anywhere.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Motel-sign pop art. Subject: Rhino at control panel below glowing NO VACANCY sign. Mood: Definitive.

cards.lore: RELEASES PROGESTERONE LOCALLY TO STOP SPERM-SWIMMERS AT THE GATE.
cards.gradeReason: Turtle inside energy-shield bubble = localized action perfectly distinguished from systemic pill.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Sci-fi-shield comics. Subject: Turtle coiled inside glowing dome blocking sperm at cervical gate. Mood: Impenetrable.

cards.lore: CREATES LOCAL INFLAMMATION-RIOT. Can make menses heavier.
cards.gradeReason: Armadillo with spear igniting hostile lightning = hostile-environment contraception embodied instantly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Elemental-warrior illustration. Subject: Copper-plated armadillo hurling spear amid electrical spermicide discharge. Mood: Hostile welcome.

cards.lore: STOPS LH SURGE. Works only before the egg is released.
cards.gradeReason: Cheetah racing an egg with legs — 72-hour window and mechanism in one visual. Critical safety message delivered.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Sprint-race comics. Subject: Cheetah overtaking panicked running egg in 72-hour countdown track. Mood: Racing against time.

cards.lore: BENCH IS EMPTY. FSH goes into Overdrive (>30 IU/L) without Stella.
cards.gradeReason: Old elephant leaving stage as FSH overdrive calls out = menopause sequence crystallized perfectly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Retirement-ceremony comics. Subject: Aging elephant taking final bow as FSH-character shouts into microphone. Mood: Twilight.

cards.lore: WITHOUT GLUCOSE, THE TUNNEL THINS AND THE LACTO-GARDE DIES OUT.
cards.gradeReason: Lizard in cracked dried tunnel = vaginal atrophy as ecological collapse. Vivid and teachable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Desert-wasteland illustration. Subject: Iguana in dried cracking vaginal-tunnel void of flora. Mood: Parched desolation.

cards.lore: STELLA MUSCLED THE BONE-CRUSHERS. Now they are free to destroy.
cards.gradeReason: Woodpecker drilling into bone = osteoclasts unleashed without estrogen. Possibly the sharpest single card in the deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Anatomy-horror comics. Subject: Red woodpecker drilling into crumbling bone column, estrogen-guard absent. Mood: Relentless destruction.

cards.lore: BRAIN'S THERMOSTAT GLITCHES DUE TO ESTROGEN WITHDRAWAL.
cards.gradeReason: Iguana on fire at thermostat control panel = thermoregulatory glitch explained with one image.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Meltdown editorial comics. Subject: Iguana on fire jabbing broken thermostat dial, steam erupting. Mood: Unbearable heat.

cards.lore: FINAL ANSWER FOR FIBROIDS/CANCER. Hormones stay if ovaries stay.
cards.gradeReason: Gorilla with crane is dramatic but total vs. subtotal distinction dilutes single-character performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Demolition-crew comics. Subject: Gorilla operating crane removing stone fortress block labelled uterus. Mood: Decisive.

cards.lore: FIXES ECTOPICS VIA TINY HOLES. Beware the Phrenic-Phantom (shoulder pain).
cards.gradeReason: Mech-suit with tiny trocar ports + 'Phrenic-Phantom' side effect named and embodied — outstanding card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Sci-fi surgical comics. Subject: Sleek robotic suit entering via three tiny port-holes, shoulder ghost lurking. Mood: Precise.

cards.lore: THE RESET-BUTTON FOR HEAVY BLEEDING OR A MISCARRIAGE-MELT.
cards.gradeReason: 'Reset-Button' lore line does the teaching without the textbook. Badger-construction imagery is punchy.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Renovation-crew comics. Subject: Badger with drill and curette clearing debris from uterine interior. Mood: Purposeful reset.

cards.lore: PREVENTS 2ND-TRIMESTER LOSS. Removed when Labor-Lions are ready.
cards.gradeReason: Spider stitching gate shut = cervical cerclage as mechanical locking. 'Labor-Lions' removal cue is inspired.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Gothic-engineering comics. Subject: Spider weaving stitches across cervical gate, egg silhouette behind. Mood: Protective tension.

cards.lore: >160 THINK INFECTION. <110 think Cord-Crush.
cards.gradeReason: Bear with glowing heart + two-boundary lore = normal FHR range encoded as bouncer rule.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Vital-signs comics. Subject: Calm bear cradling glowing heart between two threshold markers 110-160. Mood: Steady vigilance.

cards.lore: OCCASIONAL IS OKAY. Recurrent means baby loses oxygen during squeeze.
cards.gradeReason: Dog firefighter with kinked hose = umbilical cord compression. Recurrent/occasional distinction in lore is teaching gold.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Emergency-drama comics. Subject: Dog firefighter tangled in kinked hose mid-alarm, V-shaped monitor behind. Mood: Knotted tension.

cards.lore: UTEROPLACENTAL INSUFFICIENCY. Placenta can't keep up. Rescue needed.
cards.gradeReason: Sloth with dimming bulb after contraction peak = late deceleration timing visualized precisely.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dim-lit hospital drama. Subject: Sloth holding fading light bulb as contraction waveform peaks above. Mood: Failing.

cards.lore: BENIGN. Baby is moving down the ladder. No rescue needed.
cards.gradeReason: Small rat in helmet descending ladder = benign head compression communicated without anxiety. Perfect contrast to Late-Larry.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Adventure-explorer comics. Subject: Tiny helmeted rat cheerfully descending ladder mirroring contraction wave. Mood: Routine progress.

cards.lore: DETERMINES VERTEX (HEAD-DOWN) vs BREECH (BOTTOM-DOWN).
cards.gradeReason: Raccoon holding glowing baby showing orientation = hands-on palpation as magical detection.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Mystical-detective comics. Subject: Raccoon shaman palpating glowing womb to map baby position. Mood: Reverent precision.

cards.lore: SCORE ON APPEARANCE/PULSE/GRIMACE/ACTIVITY/RESPIRATION sums up Ringo.
cards.gradeReason: Stork with scoring clipboard grading muscular newborn — APGAR acronym embedded in lore, playable instantly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Sports-scoring editorial. Subject: Stork with clipboard grading newborn on five-category scorecard. Mood: Clinical welcome.

cards.lore: IF IT SMELLS LIKE DEAD FISH, BACTERIAL-VAGINOSIS IS PRESENT.
cards.gradeReason: Dog detective + KOH green cloud = sensory diagnostic recalled permanently through smell-memory.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Noir detective comics. Subject: Hound detective recoiling from green KOH-discharge cloud with magnifying glass. Mood: Reluctant certainty.

cards.lore: FERN-CRYSTAL MEANS THE UTERINE-FORTRESS HAS BEEN BREACHED (Water broke).
cards.gradeReason: Owl with crystalline fern-pattern slide = ROM confirmed — elegant and memorable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Laboratory mystery comics. Subject: Owl examining fern-crystal slide under microscope, amniotic fluid gleaming. Mood: Elegant confirmation.

cards.lore: IS THE BABY HAPPY? Is the mother stable? Deliver the truth!
cards.gradeReason: Mascot meta-card — charming brand anchor but doesn't teach specific OB/GYN mechanism.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Character-mascot illustration. Subject: Yellow rabbit doctor with stethoscope and speculum, defiant grin. Mood: Reassuring chaos.

cards.lore: QUEST: Identify the Outlaw and choose the weapon: Metho-the-Melt or Laparo-Laura?
cards.gradeReason: Cross-reference case links Ectopic-Eddie, Metho, Laparo in one clinical scenario — table-ready.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Wanted-poster scenario card. Subject: WANTED board for Ectopic-Eddie with two weapon choices below. Mood: Clinical urgency.

cards.power: CASE: Monitor shows heart rate dropping after contraction ends.
cards.lore: QUEST: Identify the rhythm (Late-Larry) and name the failing negotiator (Placenta-Phil).
cards.gradeReason: Fetal monitoring scenario links two cards in active diagnosis — perfect cross-reference gameplay.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Clinical-drama scenario card. Subject: Fetal monitor strip with sloth silhouette fading in dim light. Mood: Tense fadeout.

cards.power: CASE: 60yo, hasn't bled in 10 years, sudden spotting.
cards.lore: QUEST: Name the Onco-Outlaw to rule out (Edna) and the tool needed (D&C-Dan).
cards.gradeReason: Postmenopausal bleeding algorithm compressed into one card scenario — tight clinical reasoning.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Clinical-detective scenario card. Subject: Badger detective and post-menopausal silhouette, spotlight on uterine lining clue. Mood: Diagnostic.

verdict: OB/GYN packed into 56 wrestling characters and it actually works — Ectopic-Eddie alone is worth the price of entry. The hormone quartet on pages 2-3 sets up every subsequent complication card as a story engine; students who play through one chapter will never forget the Bishop Score or Mag's reflex-ray warning. Osteo-Pam's woodpecker drilling osteoclast-freed bones is the single best bone-physiology image in any educational card deck. Placenta-Phil and Rhogam-Rhonda ask a bit too much of their metaphors, but they're outvoted eight-to-one. Table-ready YES.
blurb: The entire OB/GYN curriculum wrestled into 56 unforgettable characters. From Ectopic-Eddie the wrongly-camped outlaw to Osteo-Pam the bone-driller, every mechanism has a face and a fight move. Perfect for med students who learn better through story than flashcards.

coverQA.coverVisual: 4 — FrizzleBob in steampunk OB/GYN lab, energetic and thematic
coverQA.coverTitle: 5 — 'The Pelvic Proving Grounds' is the best subtitle in the MedKayfab series
coverQA.coverVibeMatch: 5 — medical-satire tone locked from first glance; no disconnect between cover and cards
coverQA.coverOriginality: 4 — strong but consistent with MedKayfab formula rather than a leap beyond
coverQA.coverViral: 4 — 'Pelvic Proving Grounds' is quotable; 'Stay Fluffy' closer is perfect brand outro
coverQA.coverNote: The cover delivers everything it needs to: tone, brand mark, memorable title, FrizzleBob. 'BIRTH BATTLE!' and 'FETAL FIGHT CLUB!' as side callouts are pure MedKayfab. The steampunk machinery could use one more distinctly OB/GYN visual anchor to fully distinguish it from the generic template.

notes: Standard MedKayfab 2x2 grid layout, 14 content pages x 4 cards = 56 items. No RAF dice boxes present. Three font-rendering zones where decorative lore text was partially unclear at 3x zoom (Cards 1-2 stat lines, Card 7 power line). Sections clearly organized: Hormones (1-4) → Early Pregnancy (5-8) → Labor (9-12) → Obstetric Emergencies (13-16) → Gynecology (17-24) → Gyn Oncology (25-28) → Medications (29-32) → Contraception (33-36) → Menopause (37-40) → Procedures (41-44) → Fetal Monitoring (45-48) → Clinical Skills (49-52) → Mascot + Quests (53-56). Three Quest scenario cards function as clinical case review — an excellent pedagogical addition not seen in other MedKayfab decks analyzed. Side character 'Call Doc Frizzle!' gorilla with red blood cell appears on pages 4-5 as margin decoration.

quickWins: Clarify Placenta-Phil lore — 'Fueling early stops oxygen' reads slightly awkward
Consider 1-2 more Quest scenario cards for renal/cardiac OB crossovers
niceToHave: Add Preterm-Labor-Pete distinct from Pitocin-Pete for tocolysis vs. induction contrast
RAF dice box format for tabletop integration
